lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, finish copy/layout, home layout, sign_in hint/layout/redesign).
Redesigning adoption screens (adoption, redesign) is helpful and delivered multiple winning tests.
Copy changes on the path selection screen (choose_path, copy) consistently hurt performance.
Adding new screens at the finish step (finish, new_screen) showed no positive effect and hurt performance.
Notification toggles (home, notification), waiting screen info (home, wait_info), waiting redesigns (home, redesign), and finish hints (finish, hint) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently higher than the noise-corrected measured results.

candidates.title: Story scroll redesign for friend selection screen
candidates.change: Redesign the friend selection screen into a story scroll layout featuring companion personality selection cards.
candidates.why: Adoption redesigns have proven effective, and adoption drop-off is high (76.5% step conversion). Story scroll layout gives structure to selection.

guard.reason: Replacing pet selection with personality type selection loses the original screen job of letting the user choose a pet.

candidates.title: Interactive pet preview screen before adoption certificate
candidates.change: Insert a pet preview screen right before adoption certificate to verify pet animations and visual appearance before finalizing.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple reports of pet creation visual bugs or unexpected output. A preview step lets users verify before continuing.

new_pet_preview.headline: Preview Your Desktop Companion
new_pet_preview.body: See your companion in action before completing the official adoption certificate.

guard.reason: Adding a pet preview screen inside onboarding is permitted and preserves all required steps and jobs.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new flow step increases friction despite support feedback about pet previews.

candidates.title: Split layout redesign for photo upload screen
candidates.change: Redesign the custom pet photo upload screen with a split layout pairing the photo picker with clear visual framing.
candidates.why: Adoption screen redesigns consistently perform well. Photo upload mean time is high during adoption step.

guard.reason: Redesigning the photo upload screen layout while retaining photo selection maintains the screen's core job.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns consistently yield strong positive lift and address high step mean time.

candidates.title: Reorder sign-in screen after adoption certificate completion
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur right after the adoption certificate screen, letting users complete pet creation before account sign-in.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion is 76.0%. Letting users build emotional investment in their pet first increases sign-in completion.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to occur after adoption certificate completion is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in has weak evidence and previously resulted in neutral conversion change.

candidates.title: Pet personality quiz screen during adoption
candidates.change: Add a pet personality questionnaire screen during adoption to customize companion temperament.
candidates.why: Adoption step engagement screens drive positive onboarding conversion and lower early drop-off.

new_personality_quiz.headline: Companion Personality Quiz
new_personality_quiz.body: Select key traits to shape how your pet behaves on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Adding a personality quiz screen within the onboarding flow is allowed and retains all base steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding extra questionnaire screens adds setup friction and hurts funnel completion.

candidates.title: Cloud pet backup assurance badge on sign-in screen
candidates.change: Add a prominent cloud backup badge on the sign-in screen assuring users that sign-in saves and protects pet progress.
candidates.why: Top support theme (8 emails) reports pets missing or reset after sign-in. Explaining cloud sync directly addresses account fears.

components.text: Cloud Save Active: Sign in to safely sync and protect your pet profile across launches.

guard.reason: Adding a cloud backup assurance badge to the sign-in screen complies with onboarding rules and fair design guidelines.

candidates.score_note: Directly resolves top support complaint about account progress loss with simple UI addition.

candidates.title: Spotlight layout redesign for home intro launch screen
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro screen to a focused spotlight layout centered on launching the pet directly to the desktop.
candidates.why: The final onboarding step has the lowest conversion rate (64.8%) and longest mean time (5815s). A clear spotlight layout speeds launch.

home_welcome.text: Your pet is ready to join your desktop!

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen while keeping its welcome and launch function is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has the highest dropoff rate (35.2%); layout focus can help streamline completion.

candidates.title: Mascot intro centered layout on initial story screen
candidates.change: Change story screen layout to centered layout featuring an animated welcoming mascot component.
candidates.why: Mean time on the first step is very high (514s). A centered layout with mascot focuses user attention quickly.

guard.reason: Updating the story screen layout to include an animated mascot maintains its function of introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path has high baseline conversion and historical path changes tend to perform poorly.

candidates.title: Desktop launch troubleshooting hint on waiting screen
candidates.change: Display a hint on the waiting screen explaining how to locate the pet in system tray if it fails to show on desktop automatically.
candidates.why: Support received 3 bug reports about pets failing to show on desktop or app stalling during setup.

waiting.hint: If your pet doesn't show up on screen automatically, click the pet icon in your system tray to display it.

guard.reason: Adding a helpful troubleshooting hint to the waiting screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint addresses specific tray icon support tickets during waiting step.

candidates.title: Desktop control hint on onboarding finish screen
candidates.change: Add an explicit control hint on the home_intro screen teaching users how to interact with and control their new desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support mail contains confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet after setup.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open controls, interact, or customize settings.

guard.reason: Adding a desktop interaction hint to the home intro screen complies with onboarding modification rules.

candidates.score_note: Finish hints showed +2.9% measured lift and target the lowest conversion step in the funnel.
